scenes.reason: Keep the campus map spatially continuous while opening its activity journal.

layers.background: Existing campus map, input suspended only while the menu is visible
layers.far: Static soft warm backdrop above and below the central strip
layers.middle: Theme illustration: lake, campus-inspired buildings, bridge
layers.subject: Five-entry hanging scroll and right paper details
layers.foreground: Independent ginkgo branch and small leaf set
layers.atmosphere: Low opacity water highlights, reduced or paused when appropriate
layers.ui: Editable headings, status, reward explanations, CTA and close button

scenes.interruptions: Last selection wins; closing cancels pending motion/navigation; no stale CTA may run.
scenes.safeAreas: Landscape layout responds to height; 44px touch controls; portrait uses existing rotation guidance.

scenes.reason: Show a new story while preserving the scroll as the player's navigation anchor.
scenes.motion: Bookmark moves; old details leave; new theme and details crossfade with no full-screen flash.
scenes.contentTruth: Unreleased activities remain previews; archive reads actual discovered landmark IDs.

scenes.reason: Connect the illustrated preview to an existing map location without inventing event participation.
scenes.motion: Scroll recedes into the existing campus map; explicit return restores selection and list position.
scenes.constraints: No GPS bypass, no automatic check-in, no reward grant, no new external window.

review.static: Two rounds inspected; crude branch/journal/rewards replaced with layered ImageGen bitmaps; desktop and five landscape viewports checked.
review.motion: 37 native browser checks plus 12 fault/lifecycle checks; opening, switching, map/collection return, closing, touch, keyboard and reduced motion.
review.limitations: Owned headless Edge and emulated viewports; synthetic visibility signal, no physical mobile FPS claim.
